//: Only what is specific to THIS service lives here. Everything that depends on the environment and not on the service - the shared Redis connection string, the Serilog sinks, AllowedHosts, Kestrel limits, Environment:Type - is shipped by the Jackobo framework in its embedded EnvironmentDefaults/jackobodefaults*.json and is applied BEFORE these files. Never re-declare such a key with an empty placeholder: the application files always win and an empty value would wipe out the framework default.

ExternalApi.//: The external apis THIS service calls, one entry per dependency.

Redis.//: KeyPrefix namespaces every key this service writes. The framework refuses to register a Redis client without it as soon as a Redis connection string is configured - including one supplied by the framework environment defaults - so every service declares it.
Redis.//Shared: Redis:Shared:ConnectionString is the instance shared by all the Jackobo services; once it is configured the framework registers ISharedRedisService on its own, no code required.
Redis.//Dedicated: Redis:Dedicated:ConnectionString is owned by this service and set per environment in the appsettings.{Environment}.json files; the framework then registers IDedicatedRedisService on its own, no code required.

Logger.//: Identifies the service in Elasticsearch. Declared once here - every Jackobo log formatter falls back on it. The sinks themselves come from the Jackobo framework environment defaults, so this service declares no Serilog section at all. A service that needs a sink of its own still declares it under its own key in Serilog:WriteTo.
